_metadata.dataset: Gulmi Palika 12-Month Agro-Hydrological Climatology & Root-Zone Water Balance

governance.tier: CALCULATED EMPIRICAL (1991–2020 CHIRPS Climatological Baseline & Physical Balance)
citations: Funk et al. (2015) The climate hazards group infrared precipitation with stations (CHIRPS)
Allen et al. (1998) FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 56 (Penman-Monteith)
Nepal Agricultural Research Council (NARC) Soil Science Division
Department of Hydrology and Meteorology (DHM), Government of Nepal

precipitation.source: CHIRPS v2.0 0.05° (~5 km) Multi-Decadal Gridded Reanalysis (1981–2025)
precipitation.p90_definition: 90th percentile of historical monthly precipitation (1981–2025), indicating a relatively wet historical condition (10% of historical years exceeded this level).

reference_evapotranspiration.temperature_downscaling: Empirical Gulmi station temperature lapse rate assumption (-5.1°C/km) relative to 1400m district baseline
reference_evapotranspiration.radiation_chain: NASA POWER / MERRA-2 GHI (kWh/m2/d) -> Rs (MJ/m2/d) -> Rns (albedo 0.23) -> Rnl (Stefan-Boltzmann + actual vapor pressure ea) -> Rn
reference_evapotranspiration.vapor_pressure: FAO-56 Psychrometric vapor deficit derived from 2m relative humidity
reference_evapotranspiration.wind_speed: FAO-56 Eq. 47 logarithmic boundary layer profile: u2 = u10 * 0.748

crop_water_demand.nature: Representative composite seasonal terrace rotation (Monsoon paddy/millet, Winter wheat/potato, Spring maize). Kc ranges from 0.65 to 1.15.

soil_water_balance.storage_model: Sequential single-bucket root-zone storage with moisture carry-over
soil_water_balance.storage_equation: St = min(TAW, max(0, S_{t-1} + Peff - ETc))
soil_water_balance.irrigation_requirement_equation: Ireq_t = max(0, ETc_t - Peff_t - max(0, S_{t-1} - (TAW - RAW)))
soil_water_balance.taw_nature: Estimated Total Available Water (TAW = 1000 * Zr * AWC) derived from available NARC soil laboratory points and regional terrace lithology.
soil_water_balance.effective_precipitation_attribution: USDA-SCS Monthly Runoff Partitioning Model (Peff). Residual rainfall not retained in root zone comprises surface runoff, deep percolation, and canopy interception.
